label: Development table, optimistic: leave one person out inside p004-p013 for every learned arm, per person for every no-weight arm, V1F in-sample for p004-p008. The detector constants were set by inspecting p004, p007 and p008, and the 90-120 s behaviour of all ten was known. Never a new-person result.
rows: valid primary rows, 90 <= t < 290 s (50,000 per person when complete)
units: RMSE and MAE of SCG in sensor mV; rmse_cal_sd = RMSE / the person's SCG calibration SD

selection.rule: MLP if M-ECG mean < 0.99 x R-ECG mean at the chosen (K, theta); otherwise ridge.

ridge_step.step: ridge part of model_selection steps 2 and 6
